name: TagGroup
description: A container for managing a set of Tags with add and remove capabilities. Renders tags in a wrapping flex layout with an optional add button.

keyboardInteraction: Tab to navigate between tags and buttons
notes: The container uses role='group' with an aria-label for screen readers.
Each tag's remove button has an accessible label.
The add button is keyboard accessible with focus-visible styling.
When disabled, all interactive elements are disabled and the group has aria-disabled.

tags.description: Array of tag items to render. TagItem: { id: string, label: string, variant?: TagVariant }.

onRemove.description: Callback fired when a tag's remove button is clicked. Receives the tag id.

onAdd.description: Callback fired when the add button is clicked. When provided, an add button is rendered.

addLabel.description: Label text for the add button.

disabled.description: When true, all tags and buttons are disabled.

do: Use to display a set of tags that users can add to or remove from.
Provide meaningful labels for each tag.
Use onRemove to handle tag removal from parent state.
Use the addLabel prop to provide context-specific add button text.
dont: Do not use TagGroup for navigation — use Tabs or Breadcrumbs.
Do not put more than 20 tags in a single group.
Do not use as a replacement for a multi-select — use Combobox instead.
